description: Causation-and-responsibility reasoning specialist. Arbiter does NOT gather or verify evidence itself and does not call Sentinel, Trustline, Precedent, or Atlas directly — it expects ORCHESTRA to assemble and pass in findings via the task payload/context.

capabilities.name: reconstruct_timeline
capabilities.description: Reconstructs a chronological sequence of events from raw evidence, logs, and claims. Does not determine responsibility splits.

capabilities.name: analyze_causation
capabilities.description: Identifies true root cause of project delay, defect, or dispute using multi-agent evidence context. Does not retrieve contract precedents.

capabilities.name: assess_responsibility
capabilities.description: Attributes contractual responsibility and financial split percentage between vendor, buyer, and external factors. Does not perform verify progress audits.

capabilities.name: analyze_dispute
capabilities.description: Runs full dispute analysis including timeline, causation, and responsibility attribution. Does not update vendor trust scorecards.

capabilities.name: run_debate
capabilities.description: Runs the 3-step adversarial debate: Buyer Advocate -> Vendor Advocate -> Judge. Does not do RAG vector precedent lookups.
